concerns.text: The idea's Evaluation step requires 'Compute Precision, Recall, F1-score, and AUC-ROC', but FR-006 and the success criteria only quantify AUC-ROC and F1. Precision and Recall are dropped without justification — add them to the reported metrics or note the deliberate omission.

Constitution VI requires Mann-Whitney U validation 'independent of phylogenetic structure'. FR-005 performs the tests but nothing in the spec addresses phylogenetic confounding (e.g., stratification or a phylogeny-aware check), which the idea's related work (foundation-model paper on OOD/phylogenetic diversity) also motivates. Add an explicit requirement or assumption covering this.

The threshold sweep {0.3, 0.5, 0.7} (FR-007/SC-004) is not in the source idea. It is plausibly implied rigor for the 0.5 default threshold and is small in scope, so I do not ask for removal — but the Assumptions section should explicitly tie it to the research question (robustness of the predictive-value claim) rather than leaving it as an unexplained addition.
